OVC West Division champions |bowl=[[2015 National Invitation Tournament|NIT]] |bowl_result=Quarterfinals }} {{2014–15 Ohio Valley Conference men's basketball standings}} The '''2014–15 Murray State Racers men's basketball team''' represented [[Murray State University]] during the [[2014–15 NCAA Division I men's basketball season]]. The Racers, led by fourth year head coach [[Steve Prohm]], played their home games at the [[CFSB Center]] and were members of the West Division of the [[Ohio Valley Conference]]. They finished the season 29–6, 16–0 in OVC play to win the West Division championship and the overall OVC regular season championship. After a 2–4 start, the Racers won 25 games in a row before losing in the championship game of the [[2015 Ohio Valley Conference men's basketball tournament|OVC tournament]] to Belmont.{{cite web | author =Kyle Ringo | title =Ticket Punched: Murray State miscue allows Belmont to hit winner | website =[[Yahoo! Sports]] | date =March 7, 2015 | url =https://sports.yahoo.com/blogs/ncaab-the-dagger/ticket-punched--murray-state-miscue-allows-belmont-to-hit-winner-023051741.html | accessdate = March 8, 2015}} As a regular season champion who failed to win their conference tournament, they received an automatic bid to the [[2015 National Invitation Tournament|National Invitation Tournament]] where they defeated UTEP in the first round and Tulsa in the second round before losing in the quarterfinals to Old Dominion. On June 8, head coach Steve Prohm resigned to take the same position at [[Iowa State Cyclones men's basketball|Iowa State]].{{Cite web|url=https://www.espn.com/mens-college-basketball/story/_/id/13036396/iowa-state-cyclones-hire-steve-prohm-murray-state-racers-new-coach|title=Prohm takes Iowa State job, leaves Murray St|date=8 June 2015}} He finished at Murray State with a record of 104–29 in four seasons. ==Roster== {{CBB roster/Header|year=2014|team=Murray State Racers|sex=m|hdr_bgcolor=#000000|hdr_txtcolor=#FFcc00|subhdr_bgcolor=#FFcc00|subhdr_txtcolor=#000000|teamcolors=yes|high_school=yes}} {{CBB roster/Player|first=Wayne |last=Langston |num=0 |pos=F |ft=6 |in=7 |lbs=225 |class=jr |cur_rs= |rs= |high_school=[[Dr. Henry A.
